description_text:
Wooden pier module with railing 3D Model. Single object, to be used as is (you can create a long catwalk by using an array or vector modifier). Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons), no poles.
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.79 (Cycles materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles for Blender 3D 2.7x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.79)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.79 with Cycles materials); other: png with Alpha.
1 Object (mesh), 1 PBR Material, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons), no poles; 26832 vertices, 26350 quad faces (52700 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height);so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.79 + Cycles using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

description_text:
Small stone village house that was created using Blender. This is a village house that can be used in game development, animations, scenes and much more. It is made up of a stone wall material for the walls, a wooden material for the wooden support beams, doors, and planks, and a transparent material for the glass windows. It also uses a dark metallic material for the handle on the wooden door in the stone gates.
You can add other assets inside the building and be able to see them through the windows on the sides. The model is scaled to the epic skeleton that is found in the unreal engine.
Features:

  - Uses metalness workflow and is PBR ready

  - Includes 8 2K textures and 8 4K textures

  - Includes optional normal maps to increase the level of detail of the textures

  - Textures can be edited in any photo editing software

  - Diffuse textures use alpha transparency for glass to become transparent

  - Overlapping UVs on mirrored/duplicate parts of the mesh to save texture space

  - Model has been unwrapped with matching textures to its UVMap

  - Model is exported in 4 file formats (FBX, OBJ, 3DS, DAE/Collada)

  - Native blend file is included with pre-applied textures and materials

Included Texture Types:

  - AO, Diffuse(Alpha), Roughness, Gloss, Metallic, NormalMap

  - UVLayout

description_text:
This building has 4 residential floors with medium range priced apartments with floor-to-ceiling windows for bright interior spaces, large balconies with secured glass railing and a huge terrace for the apartments on the first floor. The terrace has an exterior-treated wooden structure designed to make a customisable garden, suitable for hanging plants too. The first floor terrace is divided for the two apartments, having 64 and 77 sqm. The apartments on the upper floors also have large balconies, at 6 and 12 sqm. You can also see the wooden grilles on the sides of the building which do not only have a decorative role but they also cover the large bathroom windows for gaining extra privacy in case there exists an another building close enough. The windows are made of reflective mirror style glass, not allowing to see from the outside in.
The ground floor was designed as a commercial space with mixt use, suitable for a small neighbourhood supermarket, having a surface of 406 sqm. Considering it would be a commercial space, this is why it has very large windows but also a blank wall on the eastern side, suitable for creating a logistical entrance.
The download file is a .zip archive where you will find the project, the textures used and the photos above. The model was rendered using Raylectron.

description_text:
PRODUCT DESCRIPTION
Street Bench-3d model ready for Virtual Reality (VR), Augmented Reality (AR), games and other real-time apps. Textures made for PBR shader system. Includes several modifications.
Model is ready for use in Unity, Unreal engine 4 without additional settings by your side. Asset contains prepared bundles for import to Unity, Unreal engine.
Polycount:3112 tris
Model has been made using:

  - no Ngons,

  - no overlapping polygons

  - no overlapping vertex

Included Map Types:2K-Albedo (TGA)2K-Metalness (TGA)2K-Roughness (TGA)2K-Normalmap (TGA)2K-Ao (TGA)
Format file:-.Fbx-.obj-.unityasset-.3ds-.max-.ma-*.unreal
Model uses PBR textures.
The intended use for these models and its textures are first person shooters. You can downscale the textures from 2K to 1K depending on your needs but you'll get the highest resolution to decide for yourself. 
Rig, animations or sound are not included.
Get in touch:
In case of questions please contact us via email developer@eforb.ua or text us messages on our Artstation page https://www.artstation.com/eforb.
You can also visit our website: https://eforb.com/

Real-world scale.
PBR workflow ready.

Compatible with Unreal Engine, Unity, and other major 3D software.
This asset is a great choice for filling out your street or exterior locations with high-quality, efficient props.

Format - PNG.

Model is scaled to accurate real world dimensions.
Objects, materials and textures has meaningful and matching names.
Transformations has been reset and model is placed at scene origin [0, 0, 0 XYZ].
All texture paths are set to relative.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
FILE FORMATS                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
Maya - Standart Renderer
3ds Max - Scanline Renderer
FBX
OBJ
UnityPacakge                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
GENERAL                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
Modeled in Maya.
Preview images are rendered with Marmoset Toolbag.
Images are straight from rendering apps. No post processing were applied.
Render scenes are not included.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
Please contact me if you have questions or need assistance with the models.

description_text:
Car Name: SHC MCE 39
This car is rendered in realtime in Blender Eevee, to open the native Blender file, you will need Blender 2.8.
The price of this car is calculated on it's combination of parts and options in relationship to other MCE cars.The lower priced MCE cars have the same building quality as the higher priced ones, but the overal look and used parts will be better on the higher priced MCE cars.This allows me to release cars at accessable prices, and release better looking ones at a higher price. (all options for this car are listed at the bottom of the description) 
This car is made with the SHC modular car creation tool.
Custom designed parts im a high detailed brandless/generic car with real modern cars inspiration that can be used for renders, presentations, real time apps and video games without displaying or copying any real life car model.
*Detailed exterior
*Detailed interior (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed engine (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed underside
*Materials and textures without shaders are available in the exported files.
*The Studio, materials and camera/door animations are included in the Blender file that is used to create all realtime renders for this car. everything in this file is set up, you only have to move the camera and click ''render''. (roughness is generated with the default texture file)
*The car is linked into several objects to make it more suitable for animations, opening doors, rigging and modifying / tuning / customizing.
*The car is royalty free, so you are free to modify and use it in any (commercial) project as much as you want.
*Objects: 50

description_text:
Car Name: SHC MCE 35
This car is rendered in realtime in Blender Eevee, to open the native Blender file, you will need Blender 2.8.
The price of this car is calculated on it's combination of parts and options in relationship to other MCE cars.The lower priced MCE cars have the same building quality as the higher priced ones, but the overal look and used parts will be better on the higher priced MCE cars.This allows me to release cars at accessable prices, and release better looking ones at a higher price. (all options for this car are listed at the bottom of the description) 
This car is made with the SHC modular car creation tool.
Custom designed parts im a high detailed brandless/generic car with real modern cars inspiration that can be used for renders, presentations, real time apps and video games without displaying or copying any real life car model.
*Detailed exterior
*Detailed interior (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed engine (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed underside
*Materials and textures without shaders are available in the exported files.
*The Studio, materials and camera/door animations are included in the Blender file that is used to create all realtime renders for this car. everything in this file is set up, you only have to move the camera and click ''render''. (roughness is generated with the default texture file)
*The car is linked into several objects to make it more suitable for animations, opening doors, rigging and modifying / tuning / customizing.
*The car is royalty free, so you are free to modify and use it in any (commercial) project as much as you want.
*Objects: 35
File formats: (all file formats are exported with blender 2.8 default settings)*abc *blend *dae *fbx *obj *stl 
[Options]Car Body: Sports GT shooting brake
Engine: (Engine block can be removed to simulate an electric car, the mechanical parts under the hood will remain)V8

Glass Roof:Yes

description_text:
Worm gear collection modeled in Inventor 2010 and provided in multiple file formats (.IPT, .STP, .STL, .3DS, .OBJ). Collection includes 3 worm gear sizes (16-tooth, 24-tooth, and 32-tooth), 3 spur gear sizes (16-tooth, 24-tooth, and 32-tooth), and 2 worm styles (compatible with spur gears and compatible with worm gears), all fully ready for 3D printing.
The native Inventor files are fully parametric and can be opened and manipulated in any version of the software that is 2010 or newer. The feature trees and parameter tables are logically arranged and clearly labeled, making edits extremely simple.
All gears have been exported as STP files, allowing them to be opened in any 3D CAD software. They have also been exported as 3DS and OBJ files, for use in 3D graphics packages. Finally, they are provided as STL files, making them ready for 3D printing.
Strategic recesses have been engineered into the larger gears to minimize their volume for the purpose of reducing the cost of 3D printing.
Worm / spur gear set fully compatible with Spur Gear Collection 02.
No textures or materials included.
Gear specifications:

  - Approximate involute gear tooth profile

  - Minimal backlash between gears

  - 1/4 inch face width

  - 1/4 inch shaft bore

  - 16 Pitch (P) gear size

  - Pitch Diameter (PD) = Gear Teeth (T) / Pitch (P)

  - Outside Diameter (OD) = Pitch Diameter (PD) + 0.125 inch

  - Worms provided with bore for 1/4 inch ANSI D-profile shaft

  - Worm gears and spur gears provided with bore for 1/4 inch round shaft with standard ANSI 3/32 inch keyway

  - Polygon counts range from 22,016 (16-tooth spur gear) to 56,866 (32-tooth worm gear)

Product includes:

  - Worm gear set Inventor 2010 files (IPT)

  - Worm gear set STP files (for other 3D CAD packages)

  - Worm gear set STL files (for 3D printing)

  - Worm gear set 3DS files (for 3D graphics packages)

  - Worm gear set OBJ files (for 3D graphics packages)

  - Sample worm gear animation (AVI)

_CBSpicer

description_text:
Helical gear collection modeled in Inventor 2010 and provided in multiple file formats (.IPT, .STP, .STL, .3DS, .OBJ). Collection includes 3 helical gear sizes (16-tooth, 24-tooth, and 32-tooth), provided in right and left-hand orientations, all fully ready for 3D printing.
The gears are modeled with a 45-degree helix, allowing them to mate with both parallel and perpendicular shaft configurations.
The native Inventor files are fully parametric and can be opened and manipulated in any version of the software that is 2010 or newer. The feature trees and parameter tables are logically arranged and clearly labeled, making edits extremely simple.
All gears have been exported as STP files, allowing them to be opened in any 3D CAD software. They have also been exported as 3DS and OBJ files, for use in 3D graphics packages. Finally, they are provided as STL files, making them ready for 3D printing.
Strategic recesses have been engineered into the larger gears to minimize their volume for the purpose of reducing the cost of 3D printing.
No textures or materials included.
Gear specifications:

  - Approximate involute gear tooth profile

  - Minimal backlash between gears

  - 1/4 inch face width

  - 1/4 inch shaft bore

  - 16 Pitch (P) gear size

  - Pitch Diameter (PD) = Gear Teeth (T) / Pitch (P)

  - Outside Diameter (OD) = Pitch Diameter (PD) + 0.125 inch

  - Helical gears provided with bore for 1/4 inch round shaft with standard ANSI 3/32 inch keyway

  - Polygon counts range from 49,298 (16-tooth helix gear) to 53,476 (32-tooth helix gear)

Product includes:

  - Helical gear set Inventor 2010 files (.IPT)

  - Helical gear set STP files (for other 3D CAD packages)

  - Helical gear set STL files (for 3D printing)

  - Helical gear set 3DS files (for 3D graphics packages)

  - Helical gear set OBJ files (for 3D graphics packages)

  - Helical gear sample animations (.AVI)

description_text:
A sculpture of an aged statue of the sitting Buddha. This Little Buddha is not scanned in 3D, but is based on a real statue. The model and the textures were made from photos of the original statue. The textures were edited in Gimp and the model sculpted in Blender 3D.  The model comes with different versions, each with different polygon count,  two low poly versions, a medium quality version, a high poly version retopologized from the sculpt, in addition to the raw sculpt. The textures are baked from the 3D sculpture and are mapped in UV for all models. All models in .obj(object) format. Can be used as prop for VR scenes, in mobile apps, games and maybe for three-dimensional printing (not checked).
2048 X 2048 Textures

description_text:
Это водометный движатель с наклоном в 1 градус и 60мм диаметром, предназначен для RC катеров и сёрф досок! Он подходит для двигателя с левым и правым вращением, вам нужно выбрать сопло с лепестками и винт для вашего двигателя! Винтов очень много с разной тягой, (.....x..... Это тяга X сколько лепестков")! Так же я начертил эскиз для вала который вам должен выточить токарь или вы сами если есть станок, материал нержавейка размер L вы должны сами выбрать так как у всех разное расстояние от двигателя! На картинке есть резиновые прокладки от протекания воды они черного цвета, продаются в сантехническом магазине, но вырезать нужно самому! На картинках показано где нужно нарезать резьбу М5 0.8! Но у меня болты нарезали резьбу без метчика; но нет гарантий что будет тогда надежно держатся! У некоторых станок печатает на пару десяток в минус, тогда нужно будет почистить сверлом отверстия диаметром 14 мм 8.1 мм чтоб влез подшипник и вал! Так же болты нужны м5 м3 м2; гайки под м5 м3!
This is a water jet engine with a slope of 1 degree and 60mm diameter, designed for RC boats and surf boards! It is suitable for the engine with left and right rotation, you need to choose a nozzle with petals and a screw for your engine! There are a lot of screws with different thrusts, (..... x ..... This is thrust X how many petals ")! I also drew a sketch for the shaft that you need to turn a turner on or you yourself if there is a machine tool, stainless steel material you must choose the L size yourself since everyone has a different distance from the engine! The picture shows rubber gaskets from the water flowing in black, they are sold in a plumbing store, but you need to cut yourself! The pictures show where you need to cut M5 0.8 thread! But I have the bolts cut the thread without a tap; but there is no guarantee that it will then be reliably de For some, the machine prints a couple of dozen in minus, then it will be necessary to clean the holes with a diameter of 14 mm by 8.1 mm to drill the bearing and shaft! Also bolts need m5 m3 m2; nuts for m5 m3

Concrete path 1
Low poly model of Concrete path 1 with 2 different texture sets all baked in Substance Painter.
Concrete path have a huge range of uses on all kinds of properties from construction sites,  ports, roads, games, simulations(very low polygon mesh), still renders educations, presentations, animations, warehouses etc. Also perfect for architecture design scenes.
Fits well for close up renders.
Tested in 3ds Max and Blender – may need minor material changes for your needs.
• Modelled in Cinema4D R19.
• Drag and drop, ready for render (for octane users and standard Cinema render, 3ds Max and Blender)
• No plugin needed.
• Coordinates in space (X=0, Y=0, Z=0)
• Files with the model does not contain hidden objects (lights, cameras,decorations, etc.)

• blend 2.80
• fbx (2 files - 6.1v , 7.1)
• tex rar textures made in Substance Pinter All texture maps 2K !
• Polygons – 34

Previews rendered in Cinema 4D using Octane. Please note that the studio scenes and light and environment settings are not included.

description_text:
A floating gear clock. The large gear simply sits on the small one that attaches to the minute hand shaft.
The small gear has 2 washers that you glue to it to prevent the large hanging gear from walking off the edge.
The case gear simply hides the clock body.
Once you glue the 2 washers to the small gear, you will need to press fit it onto the clocks minute shaft (see close up photo) and glue it in place with a small amount of super glue (be sure to not get the glue on the hour or second sections).You can paint the numbers and tick marks as I have done in the photos

  - Model is scaled to proper real world dimensions. 

  - Scene units are in cm. 

  - All objects, materials and textures are properly and uniquely named. 

  - All transformations are reset and model is placed at scene origin. 

  - All texture paths are set to relative. 

  - Materials are prepared for Corona renderer. 

  - Textures are collected in one arhive and are delivered in separate file. 

  - Render scene is not included. 

  - Scene has 4 high quality textures up to 1569x1569 resolution. 

  - File formats available: max - fbx - obj - stl 

  - Files other than max, may not have all features available, due to format restrictions. 

  - Some of most common restrictions are: 

  - max scene with scanline renderer - contains simplified materials 

  - fbx - contains simplified materials 

  - obj - contains simplified materials, has no vertex colours s

  - tl - has no materials, has no vertex colours, has no UV coordinates 

*** 
Please contact me if you have questions or need assistance with the models.

description_text:
When i got my printer i wanted to print a case for my power bank. Since Xiaomi is not a famous company i could not find a single model that would work with my 20000 mAh power bank.So i decided to create one myself.The power bank fits great and even without the cap the power bank will not fall of the case even when being held upside down.Its easy to get it out with a push and the cutout is pretty handy to check the battery level on the go.The cap is designed outside the case and to provide access to all ports (1 X  micro USB for charging and 2X USB Type A for powering your devices. Also the cap is made so you can see the battery indicator so you never have to guess about the charge of the power bank.
Power Bank Case Specs1) 1.5 mm thick walls and bottom 2) Tight fit so it can be used without the cap3) Power Level Button cutout to check the battery level without having to take the power bank out of its case
Cap Specs1) Accessibility to all ports2) Accessibility to battery level indicator LED's3) Tight fit with the case 4) 1.5 mm thick top and sides
Printing Settings1) 100 % infill so that it is tough2) 0.3 mm layer height (if you are patient you could use 0.2  mm layer height 3)Printing speed depends on your printer4)No need for supports when printing the cap(with proper orientation)5) Need for supports when printing the case to help the button cutout come out great
Extra info 1) The case in the photos was printed a bit sloppy since i had not calibrated my printer well (The 2 patters come from overextrusion that i tuned in the middle of the print)2)BE WARNED : after regular use the fit on the cap gets a bit loose and it tends to fall off (i have used the case for about 3 months now) the case fit is the same being great ( i now do not use the cap to be honest at all)
I hope you enjoy the case as much as i do.

3D model of Maru pendant light by L&G Studio. Globe size is 10 inches, pendant height is 17 inches.
***MODEL*** Pendant model is made from 5 polygonal objects. All objects are made with subdivision in mind and have Turbosmooth modifier applied. Turbosmooth is instanced for convenient usage. ***MATERIALS*** Materials are prepared for Corona, V-ray and Scanline renderers. Materials originally were authored in 3ds Max for Corona renderer and converted to V-Ray. Due to differences between renderers and possible imperfections in conversion process, V-Ray output might look slightly different than in preview images. Scanline and FBX files has only basic materials and will NOT render the same as in preview images. OBJ file has no materials, but has UVW coordinates intact.
***TEXTURES*** Model has 4 textures of up to 4096 x 4096 resolution. Textures are saved in PNG and JPG formats. Textures are collected in one archive and are delivered in separate file. Unpack textures into the same folder as the model files and 3ds Max should pick up textures automatically.
***SCENE*** Model is scaled to proper real world dimensions. Scene units are in cm. All objects, materials and textures are logically named. All transformations has been reset and model is placed at scene origin [0, 0, 0 XYZ]. All texture paths are set to relative. Objects are separated by materials and named accordingly. All objects in MAX file are logically placed into layers.
***FILE FORMATS*** 3ds Max - Corona 3ds Max - Vray 3ds Max - Scanline FBX OBJ - subdivided OBJ - not subdivided
***GENERAL*** Modeled in 3ds max. Preview images are rendered with Corona renderer. Render scenes are not included.

In this package you will find a rough asphalt material, as you would find it on streets, and a smoothed out mix of asphalt and concrete, as you would find it in a parking lot or street transition.
The contained materials are of high quality (2048x2048), use the Physically Based Rendering approach and are ready-to-use with the Standard Shader in Unity. Of course, all necessary textures are provided, so feel free to use these material in any other 3D rendering software as well.
The materials are seamlessly tileable and great for your realistic outdoor areas. The original footage was shot in Japan.

description_text:
this is a model of a city rendered in blender cycles, this is useful for desktop backgrounds, landscape renderings etc. This model has micro displacement setup which is used for the greeble  on the floor.
All buildings in the blend file are created by using objects modeled in blender using a particle system to distribute them. The fbx and obj file have the particle objects converted to mesh. 
In addition to the blender file I also provided an obj and an fbx file for use with programs other than blender.
The blend file has a compositing node setup which was used to create the glare and compositing effects for the final render. materials are all procedural and no image textures were used, all procedural textures were created with nodes in blender.

description_text:
A kerosene lamp is a type of lighting device that uses kerosene as a fuel. Invented by the Polish pharmacist Ignacy Łukasiewicz in 1853, kerosene lamps have a wick or mantle as light source, protected by a glass chimney or globe; lamps may be used on a table, or hand-held lanterns may be used for portable lighting. Like oil lamps, they are useful for lighting without electricity, such as in regions without rural electrification, in electrified areas during power outages, at campsites, and on boats. There are three types of kerosene lamp: flat-wick, central-draught (tubular round wick), and mantle lamp. Kerosene lanterns meant for portable use have a flat wick and are made in dead-flame, hot-blast, and cold-blast variants.
Suitable for mobile, AR, VR and PC. Works with Unreal Engine 4 and Unity.

description_text:
Baiterek (also Bayterek) is a monument and observation tower in Astana, Kazakhstan
The shape of Bayterek represents a poplar tree holding a golden egg. These come from a folktale of the tree of life, a central symbol in Turkic mythology, and Samruk the magical bird of happiness, said to have laid its egg between the branches of a poplar tree.
The 105m tall structure rises from a wide flat base within a raised plaza. It consists of a narrow cylindrical shaft, surrounded by white branch-like girders that flare out near the top, supporting a gold-mirrored 22m-diameter sphere. The base contains a ticket booth and exhibition space, with two lifts rising within the shaft to the observation deck within the 'egg'. Entrances to the monument are sunk below eye level, reached by stairs from the surrounding plaza.
The observation deck is 97m above ground level, corresponding to 1997, the year that Astana became the nation's capital. It consists of two levels, one with 360 degree views of Astana and beyond, with a second, higher level, reached by a flight of stairs. The top level features a gilded hand print of the right hand of Nursultan Nazarbayev, the first President of the independent Republic of Kazakhstan, mounted in an ornate pedestal. A plaque invites visitors to place a hand in the imprint and make a wish. Alongside the handprint, and also oriented in the direction of the presidential palace, is a wooden sculpture of a globe and 16 radiating segments, commemorating the Congress of Leaders of World and Traditional Religions, held several times in Astana.
A tourist attraction popular with foreign visitors and native Kazakhs alike, it is emblematic of the city, which became capital of the country in 1997
Height: Antenna spire: 105 m (344 ft) Top floor: 97 m (318 ft)

This car is rendered in realtime in Blender Eevee, to open the native Blender file, you will need Blender 2.8.
The price of this car is calculated on it's combination of parts and options in relationship to other MCE cars.The lower priced MCE cars have the same building quality as the higher priced ones, but the overal look and used parts will be better on the higher priced MCE cars.This allows me to release cars at accessable prices, and release better looking ones at a higher price. (all options for this car are listed at the bottom of the description) 
This car is made with the SHC modular car creation tool.
Custom designed parts im a high detailed brandless/generic car with real modern cars inspiration that can be used for renders, presentations, real time apps and video games without displaying or copying any real life car model.
*Detailed exterior
*Detailed interior (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed engine (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed underside
*Materials and textures without shaders are available in the exported files.
*The Studio, materials and camera/door animations are included in the Blender file that is used to create all realtime renders for this car. everything in this file is set up, you only have to move the camera and click ''render''. (roughness is generated with the default texture file)
*The car is linked into several objects to make it more suitable for animations, opening doors, rigging and modifying / tuning / customizing.
*The car is royalty free, so you are free to modify and use it in any (commercial) project as much as you want.
*Objects: 47
File formats: (all file formats are exported with blender 2.8 default settings)*abc *blend *dae *fbx *obj *stl 
[Options]Car Body: Mid Size 4 door suv
Engine: (Engine block can be removed to simulate an electric car, the mechanical parts under the hood will remain)4 cilinder

description_text:
Car Name: SHC MCE 28
This car is rendered in realtime in Blender Eevee, to open the native Blender file, you will need Blender 2.8.
The price of this car is calculated on it's combination of parts and options in relationship to other MCE cars.The lower priced MCE cars have the same building quality as the higher priced ones, but the overal look and used parts will be better on the higher priced MCE cars.This allows me to release cars at accessable prices, and release better looking ones at a higher price. (all options for this car are listed at the bottom of the description) 
This car is made with the SHC modular car creation tool.
Custom designed parts im a high detailed brandless/generic car with real modern cars inspiration that can be used for renders, presentations, real time apps and video games without displaying or copying any real life car model.
*Detailed exterior
*Detailed interior (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed engine (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed underside
*Materials and textures without shaders are available in the exported files.
*The Studio, materials and camera/door animations are included in the Blender file that is used to create all realtime renders for this car. everything in this file is set up, you only have to move the camera and click ''render''. (roughness is generated with the default texture file)
*The car is linked into several objects to make it more suitable for animations, opening doors, rigging and modifying / tuning / customizing.
*The car is royalty free, so you are free to modify and use it in any (commercial) project as much as you want.
*Objects: 39
File formats: (all file formats are exported with blender 2.8 default settings)*abc *blend *dae *fbx *obj *stl

description_text:
Rusty watering Can low-poly optimized 3D model ready specifically setup for Unreal Engine 4 (UE4). Made in Blender to scale and textured in Substance Painter. (All images rendered in UE4)
3D: uasset, fbx, obj, dae, 3ds.
Textures: 4096x4096 and 1024x1024 both PNG

  - WateringCan_BC (Base Color)

  - WateringCan_M (Red = Metallic, Green = Roughness, Blue = Color Mask)

  - WateringCan_N (Normal Map)

  - WateringCan_BaseNormal (It's not used by anything, but included in case you want to re-texture and remove the rust)

FOR UE4 ONLY You will find two folders named WateringCan and WateringCan_Optimized. You can simply drag and drop one of those folders into the ../Content folder of your UE4 project and you will get everything ready to use.

  - WateringCan includes the 4k (4096) textures and a Material Instance allowing you to change the Color, Metalness and Roughness of the paint on the can.

  - WateringCan_Optimized only includes the 1024x1024 textures (Dark Blue as seen on the 3rd picture) and no material instance. I recommend you chose this option for the sake of performance and saving disk space.

Of course you can also take the material instance version and put the 1024 textures on it and it'll work just fine.
Both version include LODs (Level of Details) already setup and generated in UE4:

  - LOD0 = 2,318 tris

  - LOD1 = 1,042 tris

  - LOD2 = 115 tris

  - LOD3 =  46 tris

It'll be my pleasure to help or answer any questions you have for this model.

Car Name: SHC MCE 27
This car is rendered in realtime in Blender Eevee, to open the native Blender file, you will need Blender 2.8.
The price of this car is calculated on it's combination of parts and options in relationship to other MCE cars.The lower priced MCE cars have the same building quality as the higher priced ones, but the overal look and used parts will be better on the higher priced MCE cars.This allows me to release cars at accessable prices, and release better looking ones at a higher price. (all options for this car are listed at the bottom of the description) 
This car is made with the SHC modular car creation tool.
Custom designed parts im a high detailed brandless/generic car with real modern cars inspiration that can be used for renders, presentations, real time apps and video games without displaying or copying any real life car model.
*Detailed exterior
*Detailed interior (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed engine (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed underside
*Materials and textures without shaders are available in the exported files.
*The Studio, materials and camera/door animations are included in the Blender file that is used to create all realtime renders for this car. everything in this file is set up, you only have to move the camera and click ''render''. (roughness is generated with the default texture file)
*The car is linked into several objects to make it more suitable for animations, opening doors, rigging and modifying / tuning / customizing.
*The car is royalty free, so you are free to modify and use it in any (commercial) project as much as you want.
*Objects: 43

description_text:
The original Scissor Snake was fun, but could be hard to print and was impossible to reconfigure or repair. This improved Scissor Snake Construction Set is EASY to print, can be assembled into all the classic scissor snake configurations, can be extended by adding any number of additional stages. and can be repaired if broken.
IncludesScissor Snake Complete Build Plate - includes all the parts you need to make one tapered 4 stage Scissor Snake with a realistic Python Head.Realistic Python head assemblyCenter stage assemblyExtra PinsScissor Snake pin locking tool
InstructionsPrint at 0.1mm layer height with support. Use at least 30% in-fill. For maximum strength, use 100% in-fill.
AssemblyEach bone is marked with either a DOT or a DASH symbol. 1) Locate all the bones marked with a DOT. Insert two pin half pieces into each bearing opening from the DOT side. These must turn freely.2) Locate the matching DASH piece for each bone. The sides without symbols go next to each other. Snap the pieces together at the center bearing by inserting one end of the pin first, then pushing the pieces together. You should hear a snap. Insert the printed tool into the bearing from the DASH side while pushing on the pin with your finger from the DOT side. Rotate the pin 90 degrees with the tool while holding the DASH bone. The pin should snap into place parallel to the DASH symbol. Repeat for each stage.3) Rotate the bones of each stage so that the DOT symbol is facing UP and appears on the LOWER LEFT and UPPER RIGHT section of the X formed by the bones. IMPORTANT: You may need to rotate the bones over 180 degress (cross them) to get the correct orientation, otherwise the snake will not assemble.4) Combine the stages as desired using the same technique, however there is one unbreakable rule for combining the stages: a)  DOTs must be all on one side and all DASHs must be on the opposite side of the snake; only join DOT to DASH. Additionally, it works best if you always join arms of the same length. Otherwise you can combine the stages however you desire.
Python Head1) This is the only piece that needs support. Carefully remove all of the support material from the underside of the pieces and clean out the holes. Insert the DOT piece into the top of the python head. It snaps into place. Insert the DASH piece into the bottom of the python head as shown in the photos.

This is my first and smallest 3d printed bowl feeder. You get both the .stl files for printing as well as the SolidWorks files for modification. You can see a video of it running with M3 hex nuts here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xXfcDdvP9jU

description_text:
Hello people! Here is the Three-Cylinder Engine!
• Fully functional• Easy to assemble• 6 individual parts (total of 12)• Perfect tolerances between parts• Can be used for educational purposes
ASSEMBLY
Parts are quite simple, you can understand where to put for each part at the first sight.
You will need some metal paper clips and ordinary wooden skewers cut into specific lengths for combining Connecting Rod (conrod) - Rod Clamp (rodclamp) together and Piston (piston) - Connecting Rod (conrod) together.
Note: These skewers and clips are not essentials. You can just carefully super glue Connecting Rod - Rod Clamp together. For Piston - Connecting Rod, you can model and print a pin with 2.5 mm diameter and use it instead.
After you assemble crank, pistons, conrods, rodclamps all together, fit piston heads through upperblock then let crank take its place.
Place the lowerblock into its position then fix it with super glue after you give crank a test-spin.
All of the moving parts should rotate freely without any restrictions. If you have a problem with rotating free then you need to check;
• the Y-Plate to be perpendicular to the X-axis• the extrusion multilier (under/over extrusion)• any possible surface problem on models caused by your printer
PRINTING
Layer Height;for piston, conrod, rodclamp: 0,1 mmfor lowerblock, upperblock crank: 0,2 mm
Infill: minimum of 30% for each part

description_text:
A turbopump is a propellant pump with two main components: a rotodynamic pump and a driving gas turbine, usually both mounted on the same shaft, or sometimes geared together. The purpose of a turbopump is to produce a high-pressure fluid for feeding a combustion chamber or other use.
There are two types of turbopumps: a centrifugal pump, where the pumping is done by throwing fluid outward at high speed, or an axial-flow pump, where alternating rotating and static blades progressively raise the pressure of a fluid.
Axial-flow pumps have small diameters but give relatively modest pressure increases. Although multiple compression stages are needed, axial flow pumps work well with low-density fluids. Centrifugal pumps are far more powerful for high-density fluids but require large diameters for low-density fluids

description_text:
Hi!I created this fun little rubber band toy from scratch. Its both fun and educational. Fits for all ages that love to have fun.  Watch the video for the complete build!
Make sure to print with low layer hight to keep water resistance at a top-level.In the video I printed with wood filament, to make it look more like a wooden toy 
Printer settings for the model in the video:

  -  0.12mm layer hight

  - 15% infill

  - 0.8 nozzle.

  - 10 upper and lower layers

  - 2 layer wall thickness

  - no support

The only thing you will need is a rubber band :)
Enjoy!

description_text:
This is an update to my wildly unpopular and unknown printed end table.   For this version I applied a type of Veroni filter and used real bamboo and lilac wood for the top.   The sci-fi grunge styling with its alien looking top corners snap into place with the lilac wood inserts and top lock stops. Both the leg pieces and top corners print easily in resolutions from 200-400 microns with knock off supports included.  The printing time for these files can be long vs the other standard version so be forewarned.
Supporting a smaller living footprint this design integrates storage space into daily living. The leg pieces are hot glued on and come off easily when required. The top connecting pieces snap on and off so that the storage tub is also accessible. When moving time arrives all pieces stow inside. All pieces were printed with a $300 makibox 3D printer.   The bamboo came from my local garden centre for use  as tomato sticks I assume.   The lilac wood came from my overgrown hedge.

description_text:
This 3D model was originally created with Sketchup 8 and then converted to all other 3D formats. Native format is .skp 3dsmax scene is 3ds Max 2016 version, rendered with Vray 3.00 This 30-meter high statue of a man and a woman holding up a bouquet of flowers, was erected in 1962 to welcome the athletes participating in the Asian Games. Locally known as Bundaran HI (The HI Roundabout), it is located at the center of Jakarta's busiest roundabout, this most famous (and most beautiful IMHO) monument in Jakarta features a beautiful water feature that has recently seen a major renovation (at a major cost for taxpayers too).
Surrounded by 4 major hotels, 3 embassies, and a shopping center, this landmark does not only draw tourists but also demonstrators from all over the country. Nevertheless, this spot is still a pleasant place to visit especially at night. Interestingly although the statue was intended to welcome athletes, the statue faces north. If we come from the airport or the sports complex, we come from the south :)

description_text:
The Simpsons house! 3D print house model of the most popular family on television! Model faithful to the original design. Articulated doors (front, back and garage) and removable roof
The project has small parts, before you start printing make sure your 3D printer is well calibrated, especially in relation to extrusion factor.
Use PLA for all parts.
The project does not require supports via software.
Windows and door frames have supports incorporated in STL, and can be identified by a tab added to the support to facilitate removal.
Minimum bed size 20x20x10, and maximum nozzle diameter is 0.4mm
Printing the windows.0.18 layer heightSpeed between 20 and 40 mm/s
Printing the bay windowsKeep this piece rotated 45 ° on the table0.18 layer hightSpeed between 20 and 40 mm / s
Printing doors0.18 layer hightSpeed between 20 and 40 mm / s
Printing hinges0.18 layer hight 2xSpeed between 20 and 40 mm / s
Printing the roof0.2 layer hight (or less if you prefer)Speed between 40 and 60 mm / s
Printing wallsBetween 0.2 and 0.3 layer hightSpeed between 40 and 60 mm / s
Attention! You can print all windows together, but will get better results if you print each one individually.Print necessarily all small parts with a layer height of 0.18 mm (no more or less) to ensure the removal of the supports easily

description_text: A single-acting cylinder in a reciprocating engine is a cylinder in which the working fluid acts on one side of the piston only. A single-acting cylinder relies on the load, other cylinders, or the momentum of a flywheel, to push the piston back in the other direction. Single-acting cylinders are found in most kinds of reciprocating engine. They are almost universal in internal combustion engines (e.g. petrol and diesel engines) and are also used in many external combustion engines such as Stirling engines and steam engines. They are also found in pumps and hydraulic cylinders.

description_text:
Model by Studio Q
This chandelier was inspired by Piet Boon's Hot Kroon Chandelier. This is a contemporary chandelier that simulates melted wax over the 12 candles hosted by the centerpiece. The centerpiece also has the effect as well as an organic shape to create a pronouced and more dynamic model. The arms come in 2 sizes, a short and long arm, span from the lower end of the centerpiece. Each arm seats a candle base and candle with a bulb emulating the string top. Each candle base has a chain underneath the center hooked to a jem and wax drip element. Between each long arm dangles a metal chain.
The model was rendered in 3DS Max + V-Ray 2019. The materials seen in the render are available in 3DS Max, verisons available are 2016 + 2019. All files are zipped and the total size of all formats included is 47.6MB. Credits or mentions for model use is greatly appreciated. Please feel free to give me feedback.

description_text:
The Tilda Large Chandelier was originally designed by ArteriorsHome. I have recreated this design in a very similar style in 3D. A special thanks to them for making this model happen.
This chandelier model features a 4-tiers as that are comprised of 176 arms that span from the central spine. The lower, middle and upper tier host wooden dowles that stagger up and down around the center. The dowels are made with a slight bend to capture a more dynamic and 'natural' effect in the model. The top tier hosts the finish touch of dowels and in between the top and upper tier are the light-bulb arms of the chandelier. The light-bulb arms are hidden away in the mass of dowels when viewing it from a lower perspective. This helps to create a mystry behind the lighting source and attracts the observers curiosity.
The model was originally created in sketchup and rendered in 3DS Max with V-Ray.

       This Landing gear is extremely durable, and also extremely light, especially if printed with 50% fill density!  

       This version of Landing Gear was designed for booms that have a 10 Degree lean inward toward the center of the cotper, if your copter does not have a 10 degree lean inward then you will have to change the adapter on the end of the landing gear to match your particular copter.

Thanks for Looking! Download, Print, And Fly!

This part is designed to be a Hand Held Gimbal Mount for a Brushless camera Gimbal. This mount is used in conjunction with some Vibration Dampening Gromets to hold a Brushless Camera Gimbal, that is used for filming. The average small camera gimbal is used to mount into something like a Quadcopter, or airplane, but i decided to make a simple camera gimbal mount that you can hold in your hands, for whatever other uses you can find for your RC Camera Gimbal.   
The reason that i made this is so I can have the ability to use the camera gimbal on my quadcopter for more than just capturing smooth aerial photography, but for also capturing smooth hand held photography.

Bee3dd is a team who making 3d model best quality, you don't need worry when use our models. We take care to build the smallest detail in the model to ensure the best results. These things are not in others.Our slogan is: best quality - best price!
  - We offer all electronics 3d model ( latest and oldest ). It is place where you can find anything about technology for your project ( earlier and faster than others )

Fidelity is optimal up to a 2K render. Renders have no postprocessing.File Formats:

  - 3ds Max 2012 + Vray 2.0 full setup lighting, camera

  - 3ds Max 2012 standard

  - Cinema 4D R12 standard ( materials and textures was setup )

  - Maya 2012 standard ( materials and textures was setup )

  - Lightwave 11 ( materials and textures was setup )

  - FBX 2012

  - OBJ 2012

+ 3DS 2012Features:

  - No isolated vertices

  - No coincident vertices

  - No coincident/coplanar faces

  - Quads and Triangles only ( Clean edge flow, mostly quads, subdividable topology, no poles with more than 5 edges on the model, holding/support edges present to retain shape after subdivision )

  - Models resolutions are optimized for polygon efficiency. (In 3ds Max, the Meshsmooth/Turbosmooth function can be used to increase mesh resolution if necessary.)

  - Real-world scale ( We make 3d model from actual size and images reference. It is best for making video intro, marketing, animation, games... )

  - Naming and Organization ( All geometry is contained in a single layer structure, with the layer having the same name as the product. )

  - No special plugin needed to open scene.

+ 3ds Max models are grouped for easy selection, and objects are logically named for ease of scene management.TEXTURES:

  - Textures highquality, enough for close-up render ( 2048-4096 pixels )

  - UVWs mapping with mixed: overlapping and non-overlapping

- No texture paths referenced by the model. All texture paths were stripped from the model.Rate for ours models: We are required to assess the customer's finished product with the best quality. Let us know your comments, we are very thankful for that!Thanks you,
Best regardBee3dd team

  - Texture Types (2K PNG): base color, height, metallic, ambient occlusion, roughness, normal.

This bench model is ideal for game developers, VR/AR applications, and realistic architectural visualizations.

Car Name: SHC MCE 22
This car is rendered in realtime in Blender Eevee, to open the native Blender file, you will need Blender 2.8.

*The car is linked into several objects to make it more suitable for animations, opening doors, rigging and modifying / tuning / customizing.

description_text:
Car Name: SHC MCE 21
This car is rendered in realtime in Blender Eevee, to open the native Blender file, you will need Blender 2.8.
The price of this car is calculated on it's combination of parts and options in relationship to other MCE cars.The lower priced MCE cars have the same building quality as the higher priced ones, but the overal look and used parts will be better on the higher priced MCE cars.This allows me to release cars at accessable prices, and release better looking ones at a higher price. (all options for this car are listed at the bottom of the description) 
This car is made with the SHC modular car creation tool.
Custom designed parts im a high detailed brandless/generic car with real modern cars inspiration that can be used for renders, presentations, real time apps and video games without displaying or copying any real life car model.
*Detailed exterior
*Detailed interior (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed engine (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed underside
*Materials and textures without shaders are available in the exported files.
*The Studio, materials and camera/door animations are included in the Blender file that is used to create all realtime renders for this car. everything in this file is set up, you only have to move the camera and click ''render''. (roughness is generated with the default texture file)
*The car is linked into several objects to make it more suitable for animations, opening doors, rigging and modifying / tuning / customizing.
*The car is royalty free, so you are free to modify and use it in any (commercial) project as much as you want.
*Objects: 43

Lightweight and easy to use substance materials. Can be used in Unreal 4, Substance Painter, Substance Player and Unity 5.
This pack includes 9 sbsar Materials:

  - Basewood

  - Cracked Wallpaper

  - Ceramic Tiles

  - Rough Leather

  - Smooth Leather

  - Parquet Floor

  - Log Wood

  - Book Hardcover

  - Paper

Feel free to contact me if you have questions.
Technical Information:

  - Maps generated by the .sbsar are: Diffuse, Normal, Roughness, Metallic and Height maps

  - Texture Resolution: Up to 2048x2048. For best results stay at a minimum of 256x256

  - Tileable Variation: Possible with tweaking of basic, normal and advanced parameters

  - Supports: DirectX and OpenGL Normal Map formats.

_* All substances' resolution can be changed. Except for the leather because the Edge Detect node is resolution dependant.
** For Unity & Unreal users: Make sure you have the latest Substance Plugin installed. Otherwise your .sbsar files won't be detected._
Update: This pack has been updated for better compatibility with Unity. The Metallic output is an RGBA texture: RGB Channel for Metallic Value, Alpha channel for Roughness Value. Unity's MetallicSmoothness picks this up automatically. For Unreal, ignore the Alpha Channel in Metallic and use the Roughness output instead.

Overview
Victorian-style caged wall lamp with wick; can easily be modified to hold a bulb if preferred. Perfect for Archviz which requires a more classical feel or heritage work.
Features

  - Formats included: C4D (native), FBX, 3DS, OBJ.

  - Textures included: Colour, Reflection, Normal.

History
In the mid 17th century it was a common practice for travelers to hire a lantern-bearer if they had to move at night through the dark, winding streets. King Louis XIV authorized sweeping reforms in Paris in 1667, which included the installation and maintenance of lights on streets and at intersections, as well as stiff penalties for vandalizing or stealing the fixtures. Paris had more than 2,700 streetlights by the end of the 17th century,  and twice as many by 1730.

description_text:
Car Name: SHC MCE 18
This car is rendered in realtime in Blender Eevee, to open the native Blender file, you will need Blender 2.8.
The price of this car is calculated on it's combination of parts and options in relationship to other MCE cars.The lower priced MCE cars have the same building quality as the higher priced ones, but the overal look and used parts will be better on the higher priced MCE cars.This allows me to release cars at accessable prices, and release better looking ones at a higher price. (all options for this car are listed at the bottom of the description) 
This car is made with the SHC modular car creation tool.
Custom designed parts im a high detailed brandless/generic car with real modern cars inspiration that can be used for renders, presentations, real time apps and video games without displaying or copying any real life car model.
*Detailed exterior
*Detailed interior (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed engine (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed underside
*Materials and textures without shaders are available in the exported files.
*The Studio, materials and camera/door animations are included in the Blender file that is used to create all realtime renders for this car. everything in this file is set up, you only have to move the camera and click ''render''. (roughness is generated with the default texture file)
*The car is linked into several objects to make it more suitable for animations, opening doors, rigging and modifying / tuning / customizing.
*The car is royalty free, so you are free to modify and use it in any (commercial) project as much as you want.
*Objects: 47
File formats: (all file formats are exported with blender 2.8 default settings)*abc *blend *dae *fbx *obj *stl

[{"score": 1, "comment": "I bought this for my driving simulator city I am building - Los Injurus City for the simulator Beamng Drive.  I have a very spartan budget so this fit the bill - but I actually bought this because it not only was a good price but I really liked the look of it.  The scale is correct and it comes with things grouped into convenient sections so you can easily wrangle the not-too-bad UV's into what you need.  My needs require super-low draw-calls since our game-engine has DirectX 11 as a fall-back if Vulkan isn't supported, so I did spend a day or more wrangling UV's sewing everything up and duplicating orphan UV's with like-textures - thank-goodness for having paid for some scripts to speed that up.
That said, the way the UV's were laid out - despite not being sewn - makes things very easy to work with.  In all honesty I have seen much, much worse.
I had to make a few small adjustments to the model, just minor nit-picks as we say here, and add doors since you'll be seeing most of it from street level -  but I have those already so it's all good.  I will add an elevator shaft shortly also, but for most this building should be fine as-is unless you're running this on a direct-x 11 or older rendering engine.
Didn't find errors with this model, and did not find 'hidden' surfaces either.  Building is easy to manipulate again due to previously mentioned groups.
If you want this for a city scene outside of video games - this is GREAT - if you are going to run this in a game, be prepared to optimize it some.  I cannot even begin to complain for the price, however, and am very satisfied.  The two smaller low-rise structures can be moved independently and arranged as satellite buildings regardless if you wish to physically have them connected with the main structure or not.  That's a nice bonus.

description_text:
About this model
A worn river-crossing timber bridge, of the type the Roman empire would likely have constructed to temporarily allow their legions movement across water. While a simple model with even simpler texturing, this could provide a quick and believable gateway to adding a timber bridge to a scene. Comes fully optimised and mapped with basic textures.
History
Temporary bridges are those that must usually be constructed in haste by military engineers, from available materials, frequently under fire. The earliest types historically were pontoon bridges—i.e., floating bridges that rest on stationary boats. Pontoon bridges were constructed in ancient times by Persians, Greeks, Romans, and Mongols, the most famous being Xerxes’ 2-mile (3-kilometre) span over the Hellespont (Dardanelles).  The Romans, however, frequently built more durable military bridges, notably Julius Caesar’s timber crossing of the Rhine River and Trajan’s timber-arch span of the Danube.

description_text:
Shipping Crate - PBR, Low poly - game ready.
Made in Blender, textured in Substance Painter and Rendered in Marmoset Toolbag 3
Contains: 1 Shipping Crate -> 72_verts, 66_faces, 132_tris
Texture Workflow: Metallic 
Texture Sets: Standard, Unity, UE4 
Texture Size: 2k, PNG (Textures can always be scaled down, in any software if needed) 
[For texture setup read my short tutorial at the end of this description]
Formats: FBX, OBJ, COLLAD[DAE], BLENDER[ORIGINAL]
Real-world size: 112x112x200cm System units: centimeters
NOTE: I only provide you with Unity and Unreal Engine Textures and Not project examples. You have to Drag in, Textures and file formats into your project yourself. 
NOTE: Screenshots that are taken in unity and UE4 are in default projects, no lighting or anything has been altered. Depending on your project's settings results may be different or even better.
_______UE4 Textures Setup_______
Import Base color, Normal map and Roughness-AO-Mettalic (all baked into one map) Double click Roughness-AO-Metallic and disable sRGB.
Create Material: Drag these 3 maps into it. Base color and normal map connect to their inputs. [Some of my assets don't have a normal map, so proceed without it]
Set Roughness-AO-Metallic node to linear color (Only works if you turned off sRGB before)
Connect RED channel to AO GREEN to Roughness BLUE to Metallic
That's it.
_____Unity Note_______ 
To change to Linear Color Space:
I went to Edit>Project Settings>Player>Other Settings>ColorSpace and set it to Linear.
